name: Premium Convex Feather Flags
descriptionHtml:
Stand out from the crowd with our Premium Convex Feather Flags, designed to deliver maximum visibility and smooth visual flow at trade shows, outdoor events, storefronts, festivals, and vendor booths. The convex curved shape creates a bold, eye-catching presentation that naturally draws attention from a distance.

Available in 9ft, 12ft, and 15ft sizes, all convex feather flags are double-sided by default, allowing your branding to be visible from both directions. Your custom artwork is printed using full-color dye-sublimation on high-quality knitted polyester fabric, ensuring vibrant colors and long-lasting durability.

Each flag includes a cross base and water bag as standard, making it perfect for indoor and outdoor use. For added flexibility, you may upgrade to ground stakes or a canopy mounting kit, allowing the flag to be securely mounted directly to a canopy tent.

Built with strong yet flexible fiberglass poles, these flags are engineered to withstand regular use while remaining lightweight and easy to transport.

🔹 Key Features

🚩 Convex Feather Shape – Smooth curved design for high visual impact
📏 Available Sizes – 9ft, 12ft, and 15ft
🔁 Double-Sided Printing Included – Standard on all flags
🎨 Full-Color Dye Sublimation – Sharp, fade-resistant graphics
💪 Fiberglass Poles – Durable, flexible, and lightweight
⚓ Base Included – Cross base + water bag included
🏕️ Multiple Mounting Options – Optional ground stakes or canopy mounting kit
🧳 Portable & Easy Setup – Ideal for events, promotions, and displays

🔹 Imprint Method

🖨️ Full-Color Dye Sublimation

🔹 Materials

🧵 Graphic / Flag: Knitted Polyester
🦾 Hardware: 100% Epoxy Fiberglass
🎒 Carry Case: 600 Denier Polyester

🔹 Primary Usage

Trade shows, outdoor events, vendor booths, canopy tents, storefronts, festivals, promotions, and brand activations.

Warranty

We stand behind the quality of our products. Our warranty covers any factory defects or damage that occurs during shipping. However, please note that we do not cover damage resulting from extreme weather conditions, misuse, or any circumstances beyond our control.
